objectives_zh_TW: 利用 every day 和 right now 等線索辨別習慣與當下動作。
依語意選用現在簡單式或現在進行式。
寫三至五句對照平常與現在的活動。

practice.prompt_en: Write 3-5 sentences comparing a fictional student's usual activities with what is happening now.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 用三至五句比較虛構學生平常的活動與現在正在發生的事。

objectives_zh_TW: 用 as 加形容詞原形加 as 表達程度相同。
用 not as...as 表達某一方面不如另一方。
根據高度與重量等資料寫相同和不同之處。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 兩個 as 中間保持形容詞原形，不加 er；not as tall as 表示比較沒有那麼高。

practice.prompt_en: Write four sentences about two fictional students or objects. Include as...as and not as...as.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四句描述兩位虛構學生或兩件物品，使用 as...as 及 not as...as。
practice.sample_answer_en: Amy and Sam are both one hundred and fifty centimeters tall. Amy is as tall as Sam. Amy carries two books, but Sam carries five heavy books. Her bag is not as heavy as his bag.
practice.reading_en: Sunny and Amy are both one hundred and fifty centimeters tall. Their bags are different. Sunny carries two books, but Amy carries six books and a bottle of water. Sunny lifts both bags and says her bag is not as heavy as Amy's. They walk to class together.

practice.prompt_en: Write four sentences about a fictional student's preferences. Use both ing and to forms after like or love.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四句描述虛構學生的喜好，在 like 或 love 後分別使用 ing 與 to 形式。
practice.sample_answer_en: Amy likes reading stories on quiet afternoons at home. She likes to read one short chapter before bed. She loves drawing pictures of the characters in her books. She also loves to show those pictures to her friends.
practice.reading_en: Amy likes reading mystery stories on rainy days. She also likes to read before bed because it helps her relax. Pip loves drawing animals, and he loves to show his pictures to friends. They enjoy different activities, but both students like sharing their favorite books and pictures after class.

objectives_zh_TW: 用 already、yet 和 just 描述完成進度。
在本課句型中掌握助動詞、分詞及副詞位置。

episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 本課練 have/has already/just 加分詞；yet 放疑問句或否定句尾。不要把這些例子誤當唯一用法。

practice.prompt_en: Write four sentences about progress on a fictional project. Use already, just, and not...yet with the present perfect.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四句虛構專題的進度，用現在完成式搭配 already、just 和 not...yet。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our class is preparing a display for tomorrow afternoon. I have already finished my poster about birds. My friend has just added three colorful pictures to the display. We have not checked all the labels yet, so we will do that next.
practice.reading_en: The art show opens tomorrow. Sunny has already finished her poster, and Pip has just painted the last tree in his picture. Amy has not written her name on her work yet. The teacher asks, "Have you checked the labels yet?" They check every label together before leaving.

instruction.ja: already は完了を強調し、ここでは has と finished の間です。
instruction.ko: already는 완료를 강조하며 여기서는 has와 finished 사이에 와요.

objectives_zh_TW: 用 for 加一段時間表示持續多久。
用 since 加起點表示從何時開始持續到現在。
在持續至今的情境中搭配完成式描述居住與認識。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 先畫起點到現在的時間線：for two years 是長度，since 2024 是起點。不是看到 for 就一定用完成式。

practice.prompt_zh_TW: 設定故事在 2026 年，寫四句虛構學生的經歷，用 for 表長度、since 表起點。

objectives_zh_TW: 用 may 或 might 表達未確定的可能性。
用具體線索支持可能的解釋。
區分有證據的猜測與確定的事實。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 先說看見的線索，再用 may 或 might 推測；線索不等於證明。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences about a fictional uncertain situation. Give two clues, use may or might, and say what would confirm your idea.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句描述虛構的未確定情況，提供兩個線索，用 may 或 might 推測，並說明如何確認。
practice.sample_answer_en: The classroom lights are on after school. I can hear music behind the door. The music club might be practicing inside. Another group may be using the room for a dance lesson. I will read the room schedule to find out which group booked it today.
practice.reading_en: Dark clouds cover the sky above the school. The sports teacher puts some balls inside the gym. Amy thinks the outdoor game might move indoors, but nobody has announced a change. The class checks the notice board after lunch. A new message says the game will begin in the gym at three, so the location is now confirmed.

questions.prompt_en: What evidence makes Amy expect a possible change?
questions.answer_en: Dark clouds cover the sky, and the teacher puts balls in the gym.

questions.prompt_en: Where will the game take place according to the message?
Was Amy certain before reading the message? Give evidence.
questions.answer_en: No. Nobody had announced a change, and she thought it might move indoors.

instruction.ja: may は可能性を表し、確定した事実ではありません。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences about a familiar process. Use at least three present passive sentences and show the order.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句描述熟悉的流程，至少使用三句現在式被動句，並交代順序。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our club prepares a reading display each month. First, a theme is chosen by the members. Next, useful books are collected from the library. Short descriptions are written for the display. Finally, the books are placed on a table so students can explore the topic during lunch.
practice.reading_en: Our class makes a small newspaper every month. First, school stories are collected by the writing team. Next, each story is checked by two students. Pictures are added after the text is ready. The newspaper is printed on Friday and placed near the library. Students can take a free copy, but they should leave some for other readers.

questions.prompt_en: Who checks each story?
When are pictures added?
Rewrite: The writing team collects school stories.
questions.answer_en: School stories are collected by the writing team.

titles.ja: 過去の出来事を振り返る

objectives_zh_TW: 用 was、were 加過去分詞描述已完成事件。
用時間線索區分現在與過去的被動句。
在需要時以 by 說明動作者。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 先看事件是否發生在已結束的時間，再依主詞選 was 或 were。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences reporting a fictional school event. Include at least three past passive sentences and a finished time.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句報導虛構的校園活動，至少包含三句過去式被動句及明確的過去時間。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our school held an art show last Friday. The hall was decorated by the art club on Thursday. Twenty paintings were displayed near the entrance. A welcome message was written on the board. Many visitors enjoyed the show, and the students felt proud of their shared work.
practice.reading_en: A new reading corner was opened at our school last Monday. The old shelves were painted by the art club during the weekend. Fifty books were donated by students and teachers. A small sign was placed above the door. At the opening, the principal thanked everyone who helped. The corner is now used by students during lunch breaks.

questions.prompt_en: When was the reading corner opened?
Who painted the old shelves?
Rewrite: Students and teachers donated fifty books.
questions.answer_en: Fifty books were donated by students and teachers.

objectives_zh_TW: 用 who 子句限定所指的人。
把人物主詞和子句動詞連起來理解。
合併含有重複人物的兩個簡短資訊。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 找出要描述的人，把 who 子句緊接在該名詞後，不重複加同一個主詞。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences introducing fictional people in a club. Use at least two who clauses to identify them.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句介紹社團中的虛構人物，至少用兩個 who 子句說明所指的是誰。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our reading club has several helpful members. Amy is a student who enjoys finding funny stories. Sam is the person who designs our posters. We also have a teacher who suggests new books each month. Together, these people make the club a friendly place for new readers.
practice.reading_en: Our school needs helpers for its book fair. Students who enjoy drawing can make posters. Students who speak clearly can welcome visitors. Amy, a member of the art club, chooses the poster team. Sam joins the welcome team because he likes meeting people. Each team will meet a teacher who can explain the jobs before the fair begins.

questions.prompt_en: Which students can make posters?
Why does Sam join the welcome team?
Combine: A teacher can explain the jobs. Each team will meet that teacher.
questions.answer_en: Each team will meet a teacher who can explain the jobs.

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences about a fictional school project. Include two combined sentences with who or that and avoid repeated subjects.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句介紹虛構的校園計畫，包含兩句用 who 或 that 合併的句子，避免重複主詞。
practice.sample_answer_en: We are making a welcome display for new students. We need students who can draw clear maps. We also need a printer that produces large pictures. Amy is a helper who checks the classroom names. Our team will review the display together before we put it near the entrance.
practice.reading_en: Our class is preparing a welcome page for new students. We have a guide. The guide shows the locations of all classrooms. We also have two helpers. The helpers answer questions during lunch. Sam combines these short facts into longer sentences for the page. He checks that each sentence still names the correct person or thing and keeps the original meaning.

questions.prompt_en: What does the guide show?
When do the helpers answer questions?
Combine the two sentences about the guide using that.
questions.answer_en: We have a guide that shows the locations of all classrooms.

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences for a fictional visitor asking for information. Include two polite indirect questions and a brief reason.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 替虛構訪客寫四至六句詢問資訊，包含兩個禮貌的間接問句及簡短理由。
practice.sample_answer_en: Hello, I am visiting the museum with my class tomorrow. Could you tell me where the group entrance is? We will arrive by bus at ten. Could you also tell me if bags are allowed inside? Thank you for helping us prepare for our visit.
practice.reading_en: Sam visits a new sports center for the first time. He wants to find the swimming pool and learn its opening time. At the desk, he asks, "Could you tell me where the pool is?" The worker points upstairs and says it opens at nine. Sam also asks if towels are provided. The worker explains that visitors must bring their own.

questions.prompt_en: Where is the pool?
Are towels provided?

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences reporting a fictional conversation from yesterday. Use said that and told someone that, with clear time context.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句轉述昨天的一段虛構對話，使用 said that 和 told 某人 that，並交代時間情境。
practice.sample_answer_en: Yesterday, I talked to Sam after a difficult race. He said that he was tired, so we sat down together. He told me that he wanted some water. I brought him a bottle from my bag. Later, he said that he felt better and thanked me for helping.
practice.reading_en: On Monday, Amy said, "I am tired." She had just finished a long walk. On Tuesday, Sam told the teacher that Amy had been tired after the walk. He was describing Monday, not her current condition. He also reported her words about the school: Amy said that the library opens at eight. That opening time is still correct.

questions.prompt_en: Why was Amy tired on Monday?
questions.answer_en: She had just finished a long walk.

questions.prompt_en: Was Sam describing how Amy felt on Tuesday?
Why can opens stay in the present in the library report?
questions.answer_en: The library opening time is still correct.

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences reporting a fictional conversation from yesterday. Include one asked if or whether sentence and one reported wh-question.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句轉述昨天的虛構對話，包含一句 asked if 或 whether，及一句疑問詞開頭的轉述問句。
practice.sample_answer_en: Yesterday, Amy asked if I was ready for our club trip. I said that I still needed a map. She asked where I kept my school bag. I told her it was beside the door. We found the map inside it and packed everything before dinner.
practice.reading_en: Yesterday, the club leader spoke to Sam before the meeting. She asked, "Are you ready?" Sam said yes. She then asked where he kept the posters. He explained that they were in a box beside the door. Finally, she asked whether he could help carry the box. Sam agreed, and they moved it into the meeting room together.

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences about an imagined school change. State the current situation and use two second conditional sentences.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句描述想像的校園改變，先說明現況，再使用兩句第二類條件句。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our school does not have a garden now. If we had more outdoor space, we would grow flowers near the classrooms. If I were in charge, I would invite every class to care for one area. Students could learn about plants together. For now, we keep a few small pots indoors.
practice.reading_en: Our school has only a small yard and no garden. Amy imagines a different school: if there were more space, students would grow vegetables together. Sam would build a quiet reading corner if the school had a larger yard. These are ideas, not current plans. For now, the class has permission to put three small plant pots near a window.

questions.answer_en: The school has only a small yard and no garden.

objectives_zh_TW: 整合建議、被動句與關係子句描述校園計畫。
用轉述句記錄意見並提供具體理由。
在假設與實際計畫之間作清楚區分。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 複習時先寫問題、理由與方案，再挑適合的已學句型；不要為用句型而改變事實。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences proposing a fictional school improvement. Include advice with a reason, a relative clause, and one imagined result.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句提出虛構的校園改善方案，包含有理由的建議、關係子句與一個假設結果。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our reading room gets noisy during lunch. We should add a quiet area because many students want to read. Students who enjoy quiet study could sit there. If we had more money, we would buy soft chairs for the room. For now, we can move two spare tables away from the door.
practice.reading_en: Our class discussed a noisy reading area. Amy said that students needed a quieter place. Sam suggested moving the tables that stood near the music room. A new corner was prepared by the class last week. Students who want to read now sit there at lunch. If the school had more money, the class would also buy comfortable chairs for the corner.

questions.prompt_en: Why did the class want a new reading area?
questions.answer_en: The old reading area was noisy.

questions.prompt_en: Who prepared the new corner?
Is buying comfortable chairs a confirmed plan? Explain.
questions.answer_en: No. It is an imagined result if the school had more money.

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences about one improvement to a fictional school place. Begin with a main idea and include at least two supporting details.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句描述虛構校園場所的一項改善，先寫主旨，再加入至少兩項支持細節。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our class made the lunch area more comfortable. We moved the tables farther apart so students could walk between them easily. We also placed signs above the recycling bins. Two volunteers helped younger students find empty seats. Together, these changes made lunch calmer and easier for everyone.
practice.reading_en: Our class made the school library easier to use. First, we put clear labels on the shelves so readers could find subjects quickly. We also created a simple map showing the reading areas. Finally, two students began helping visitors during lunch. These changes did not add more books, but they helped students find and use the books already there.

titles.ja: 手がかりから推測する

objectives_zh_TW: 先找出原文明說的線索，再作合理推論。
用 probably 區分推論與明說事實。
辨認缺乏文本支持的猜測。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 每個推論都要能指出支持它的句子；人物想法、原因或時間若沒線索，就不要編造。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences about a fictional scene. Give two visible clues, one supported inference, and one thing the clues cannot tell you.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句描述虛構場景，提供兩個可見線索、一項有根據的推論及一件無法得知的事。
practice.sample_answer_en: Amy entered the gym carrying a tennis racket. A tennis ball fell from the pocket of her sports bag. She probably came to play tennis because both objects are used in that sport. However, these clues do not show how well she plays. We would need more information to judge her skill.
practice.reading_en: Ben entered the classroom with a wet coat. He shook water from his umbrella near the door, then placed it in a bucket. Outside the window, drops struck the glass and students hurried across the yard under umbrellas. Ben probably came through the rain on his way inside. The passage does not tell us how long his journey took.

questions.prompt_en: What did Ben place in a bucket?
Which two details support the inference that Ben came through rain?
questions.answer_en: His coat was wet, and he shook water from his umbrella.

questions.prompt_en: Can we tell whether Ben walked for ten minutes? Explain.
questions.answer_en: No. The passage does not say how long his journey took.

objectives_zh_TW: 從公告找出開放時間、活動時間與規則。
只根據已提供數據計算結束時間及費用。
分辨公告明說與沒有提供的資訊。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 先確認單位與活動對象，再計算；別把開館時間誤當導覽時間，也別自行假設折扣。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences for a fictional event notice. Include a start time, duration, ticket price, and rule, then calculate one result.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句虛構的活動公告，列出開始時間、時長、票價及規則，再計算一項結果。
practice.sample_answer_en: Our science workshop begins at two and lasts one hour. Each ticket costs five dollars. Visitors should bring a notebook, and food is not allowed near the equipment. The workshop will therefore finish at three. Two tickets will cost ten dollars at the price stated in this notice.
practice.reading_en: Museum notice: The museum opens at nine and closes at five. The student tour begins at ten and lasts two hours. Each student ticket costs four dollars. Please bring a notebook for the tour. Food is not allowed in the galleries. The notice does not mention group discounts. Our class will buy tickets for three students at the stated price.

questions.prompt_en: What time does the student tour finish?
How much do three student tickets cost at the stated price?
Can we assume a group discount is available? Explain.
questions.answer_en: No. The notice does not mention group discounts.

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences comparing two fictional opinions about study places. Include one checkable fact and a reason for each opinion.

practice.sample_answer_en: Our library has thirty reading seats. Amy prefers studying there because she can find reference books easily. Sam likes the classroom after school because his study partner stays there. Both choices have reasons that fit the students. The number of seats is a fact, while the preferred location depends on personal needs.
practice.reading_en: Our library has twenty computers and forty reading seats. Sam thinks it is the best place to study because the computers help him research projects. Amy prefers the garden because she enjoys fresh air while reading. Both students describe personal preferences. The numbers of computers and seats can be checked, but neither preference proves that one place is best for everyone.

objectives_zh_TW: 用問候、目的、請求、理由和結尾組成郵件。

practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫一封禮貌請求信，含問候、四至六句正文及結尾，說明具體請求、時間與理由。
practice.sample_answer_en: Dear Ms. Lee, Our science club is preparing a small display. Could we use the classroom next Tuesday from three to four? We need enough space to arrange our models before the fair. We will clean the tables and return the chairs afterward. Thank you for considering our request. Sincerely, Sam
practice.reading_en: Dear Ms. Lee, Our reading club is preparing a welcome display. Could we use the library table next Friday from one to two? We need a place where new students can see our book suggestions. We will keep the walkway clear and remove everything afterward. Please let us know if the time is available. Thank you for considering our request. Sincerely, Amy

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences telling a fictional past story. Include a setting, a small problem, a response, and an ending in time order.

practice.sample_answer_en: Last Sunday, Amy took her sketchbook to the park. First, she sat under a tree and began drawing a bird. Then a light rain started, so she moved to a covered bench. She continued drawing while she waited for the rain to stop. Finally, she finished her picture and walked home.
practice.reading_en: Last Saturday, Sam and Amy went to a park to sketch birds. First, they chose a quiet bench near a tree. While Sam was drawing, a strong wind blew his paper onto the grass. Amy picked it up before it reached a puddle. Then they moved behind a wall to avoid the wind. Finally, both students finished their pictures and returned home.

questions.answer_en: A strong wind blew it onto the grass.

objectives_zh_TW: 以清楚的立場開始意見段落。
提供兩個相關理由與具體例子。
用結論回應立場，不把意見說成事實。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 理由要解釋為什麼，例子要展示具體情況；結論不要突然加入未說明的新論點。

practice.prompt_en: Write 4-6 sentences expressing an opinion about a fictional school change. Include two reasons, one example, and a matching conclusion.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四至六句表達對虛構校園改變的意見，包含兩個理由、一個例子和呼應立場的結論。
practice.sample_answer_en: I think our class should have a weekly reading hour. It would give busy students a quiet time to read. It would also let classmates share books they enjoy. For example, a student could recommend a short story after finishing it. These benefits make a weekly reading hour worth trying.
practice.reading_en: I think our library should open on Saturday mornings. First, some students need a quiet place to study because their homes are busy. Second, weekend opening would give them more time to borrow books. For example, Sam has club practice every weekday and often misses the library hours. Saturday access could help students like him, so I support trying this idea.

questions.prompt_en: What change does the writer support?
questions.answer_en: Opening the library on Saturday mornings.

questions.prompt_en: How does Sam's example support the opinion?
questions.answer_en: His weekday club practice makes him miss library hours, so Saturday access could help.

questions.prompt_en: Name a reason other than having more time to borrow books.
questions.answer_en: Some students need a quiet place to study because their homes are busy.
